channel.title: Blog – Youssef El Hadraoui (English)
channel.description: Short technical posts on backends, cloud infrastructure and DevOps: the problem, why it happens, the fix and a snippet to reuse.

item.title: PgBouncer transaction pooling breaks django-tenants
item.description: django-tenants picks the tenant with a session-level SET search_path, which PgBouncer's transaction mode does not keep. Why queries can reach the wrong schema, and two fixes.

item.title: Argo CD automated sync neither prunes nor self-heals by default
item.description: Automated sync applies new commits, but it keeps resources deleted from Git and ignores manual changes in the cluster. The prune and selfHeal options close those two gaps.

item.title: VXLAN takes 50 bytes off every packet's MTU
item.description: VXLAN adds 50 bytes of headers to every frame, 70 over IPv6. On a 1500-byte underlay, set the overlay MTU to 1450 or use jumbo frames, or large transfers stall while pings work.

item.title: Terraform can lock S3 state without DynamoDB
item.description: Since Terraform 1.10, the S3 backend can lock state with a .tflock object next to the state file (use_lockfile = true). It has been generally available since 1.11, which deprecated DynamoDB locking.

item.title: Loki wants JSON log lines and few labels
item.description: Loki indexes labels only, so high-cardinality fields such as request or tenant IDs belong in the log line. With one JSON object per line, LogQL's json parser filters on them at query time.

item.title: tmux keeps remote work alive when SSH drops
item.description: Work on a server inside a named tmux session. If the connection drops, the shell and its running commands survive, and tmux attach brings them back. A few default key bindings cover daily use.
